title: Petra and the Drop
author: Silas Dravenmoor
blurb: Ansel Galloway, a hostage negotiator with one failure still on the board, works cases no one wants attributed. But when a burner phone that shouldn't exist starts ringing with a familiar voice on the line, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must trade the one secret worth killing for, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
